title_en: Abstinence and Hormones: What Science Says
title_fr: Abstinence et hormones : ce que dit la science
summary_en: An evidence-based look at ejaculation frequency, testosterone levels, and androgen receptor sensitivity.
summary_fr: Un regard base sur les preuves sur la frequence d'ejaculation, les niveaux de testosterone et la sensibilite des recepteurs androgenes.
body_en:
The relationship between ejaculation frequency and testosterone levels is more nuanced than popular culture suggests. The most cited study in this space is by Jiang et al. (2003), published in the Journal of Zhejiang University, which measured serum testosterone in 28 men during a period of sexual abstinence. The key finding was a significant and acute spike in testosterone on day 7 of abstinence, reaching approximately 145% of baseline levels. However, this spike was transient: testosterone levels returned to baseline by day 8 and remained there during continued abstinence. No sustained elevation was observed beyond the seventh day.

Earlier research provides additional context. A study by Exton et al. (2001) examined the acute hormonal response to orgasm and found that testosterone levels did not change significantly in the immediate aftermath of ejaculation. However, they noted a brief surge in multiple hormones including norepinephrine and prolactin. Prolactin elevation post-ejaculation may temporarily reduce dopamine receptor sensitivity, which could explain the subjective experience of reduced motivation that some men report. It is important to note that baseline testosterone levels and ejaculation frequency do not appear to have a strong long-term correlation in most studies of healthy men.

The subjective benefits reported by practitioners of sexual abstinence (increased energy, focus, confidence) may operate through mechanisms other than raw testosterone elevation. Androgen receptor density and sensitivity, dopamine system regulation, and psychological factors such as increased self-discipline and intentionality likely play significant roles. Flux allows you to track your own data objectively: by logging your NoFap status alongside your daily metrics, you can determine whether abstinence periods correlate with measurable improvements in your personal energy, mood, and vitality scores, moving beyond anecdote to personalized evidence.
body_fr:
La relation entre la frequence d'ejaculation et les niveaux de testosterone est plus nuancee que ce que la culture populaire suggere. L'etude la plus citee dans ce domaine est celle de Jiang et al. (2003), publiee dans le Journal of Zhejiang University, qui a mesure la testosterone serique chez 28 hommes pendant une periode d'abstinence sexuelle. La decouverte cle etait un pic significatif et aigu de testosterone au jour 7 de l'abstinence, atteignant environ 145% des niveaux de base. Cependant, ce pic etait transitoire : les niveaux de testosterone sont revenus a la ligne de base au jour 8 et y sont restes pendant l'abstinence continue. Aucune elevation soutenue n'a ete observee au-dela du septieme jour.

Des recherches anterieures fournissent un contexte supplementaire. Une etude d'Exton et al. (2001) a examine la reponse hormonale aigue a l'orgasme et a constate que les niveaux de testosterone ne changeaient pas significativement dans les suites immediates de l'ejaculation. Cependant, ils ont note une breve montee de plusieurs hormones incluant la noradrenaline et la prolactine. L'elevation de prolactine post-ejaculation peut temporairement reduire la sensibilite des recepteurs dopaminergiques, ce qui pourrait expliquer l'experience subjective de motivation reduite que certains hommes rapportent. Il est important de noter que les niveaux de testosterone de base et la frequence d'ejaculation ne semblent pas avoir de forte correlation a long terme dans la plupart des etudes chez les hommes en bonne sante.

Les benefices subjectifs rapportes par les pratiquants de l'abstinence sexuelle (energie accrue, concentration, confiance) peuvent operer par des mecanismes autres que l'elevation brute de testosterone. La densite et la sensibilite des recepteurs androgenes, la regulation du systeme dopaminergique et les facteurs psychologiques tels que l'augmentation de l'autodiscipline jouent probablement des roles significatifs.
